head: FocusBook starts a focus timer when you open your iPhone Duo
dek: FocusBook is a focus timer that starts when you open your iPhone Duo and pauses when you fold it shut. It was #35 among paid Productivity apps on the US App Store on 9 November.
details: You plan today's tasks on the cover screen; folded to 90 degrees it stands on your desk like a small clock. On other iPhones, turning the phone sideways starts the timer. Sessions run from 5 to 90 minutes, with breaks in between. It costs $1.99 with in-app purchases, by Osama Naeem, and needs iOS 27.
where: iPhone and iPhone Duo, App Store, $1.99
means: Starting a focus session becomes one movement instead of tapping through menus.
todo: Find FocusBook in the App Store, add today's tasks and open or turn your phone to start.
